<meta name="robots" content="noindex">

<style>
/* Integrations with Webflow (nues-integrations-section): layout and default state are native classes; this adds the runtime states.
   --int-c is the selected tool's colour (set by the script from the tile's data-int-color). */
[data-integrations]{--int-c:#635BFF}
.integrations_fx{transition:opacity .25s,transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.integrations_fx.is-out{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}
.integrations_bar,.integrations_dot{background-color:var(--int-c);transition:background-color .3s}
.integrations_info.is-auto .integrations_bar{animation:intProg 3.6s linear forwards}
@keyframes intProg{to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
.integrations_orbit.is-ready .integrations_tile{will-change:transform}
.integrations_tile{transition:filter .35s,box-shadow .35s}
.integrations_tile::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14%;border-radius:28%}
.integrations_tile-icon{transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.integrations_orbit.is-hold .integrations_tile{filter:grayscale(1) contrast(.4) brightness(1.45)}
.integrations_orbit.is-hold .integrations_tile.is-active{filter:none;z-index:4;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--int-c),0 18px 30px -16px rgba(16,25,39,.4)}
.integrations_tile.is-active .integrations_tile-icon{transform:scale(1.12)}
.integrations_tile:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #146ef5;outline-offset:4px}
.integrations_lines{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;pointer-events:none}
.integrations_lines line{stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s}
.integrations_lines.is-on line{opacity:1}
.integrations_core::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-7%;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(16,25,39,.1),0 24px 50px -24px rgba(20,60,160,.45)}
.integrations_core::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-7%;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(20,110,245,.3);animation:intPing 3s cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.3,1) infinite}
@keyframes intPing{from{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}to{transform:scale(1.45);opacity:0}}
.integrations_disc{background-image:radial-gradient(80% 80% at 30% 22%,#5a93ff 0%,#146ef5 55%,#0d55d6 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25),inset 0 -6px 14px rgba(0,30,110,.35)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.integrations_fx,.integrations_tile,.integrations_tile-icon,.integrations_lines line{transition:none}.integrations_core::after,.integrations_info.is-auto .integrations_bar{animation:none}}
</style>
<style>
/* Work card thumbnail (nues-work-grid): Card background + the site (Hero screen center) as a window rising from the bottom edge.
   Hover opens the window to the full preview and scrolls the homepage. No screenshot = 'Launching soon'. No Card background = old Main Image card. */
.work-card_media{container-type:inline-size}
.work-card_window{border-radius:1.95cqw 1.95cqw 0 0;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(16,25,39,.06),0 2.4cqw 6cqw -2cqw rgba(16,25,39,.28);transition:left .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),right .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),top .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),bottom .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),border-radius .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.work-card_shot{transition:transform 4s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1)}
@media (hover:hover){.work-card_component:hover .work-card_window{left:0;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;border-radius:0}
.work-card_component:hover .work-card_shot{transform:translateY(calc(-100% + 62.5cqw));transition-delay:.35s}}
.work-card_bg.w-dyn-bind-empty,.work-card_window:has(.work-card_shot.w-dyn-bind-empty),.work-card_media:has(.work-card_shot:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty)) .work-card_soon,
.work-card_media:has(.work-card_bg.w-dyn-bind-empty) :is(.work-card_window,.work-card_soon),.work-card_media:has(.work-card_bg:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty)) .work-card_img{display:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.work-card_window,.work-card_shot{transition:none}.work-card_component:hover .work-card_shot{transform:none}}
</style>
<style>
/* Resources (Figma 7670:106). Layout and default states are native classes (visible in the Designer); this block only adds runtime states.
   Hero: the stats light one kind of card (insights, case studies, integrations); the two card rows glide in a loop. */
.res-hero_stat,.res-hero_stat-dot{transition:opacity .35s ease}
.res-hero_stat.is-active,.res-hero_stat:focus-visible{opacity:1}
.res-hero_stat.is-active .res-hero_stat-dot{opacity:1}
.res-hero_stat:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:6px;border-radius:8px}
.res-hero_card{transition:opacity .45s ease}
[data-res-active="insight"] .res-hero_card:not([data-res-card="insight"]),[data-res-active="case"] .res-hero_card:not([data-res-card="case"]),[data-res-active="integration"] .res-hero_card:not([data-res-card="integration"]){opacity:.4}
.res-hero_row.is-running{justify-content:flex-start}
.res-hero_track{display:flex;flex:none;width:max-content;animation:resMarq var(--res-dur,70s) linear infinite}
.res-hero_track>*{margin-right:25px}
.res-hero_row.is-reverse .res-hero_track{animation-direction:reverse}
.res-hero.is-off .res-hero_track{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes resMarq{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media (max-width:767px){.res-hero_track>*{margin-right:16px}}
/* Notes, news and updates */
.res-post_img{transition:transform .6s ease}
.res-post_title{transition:opacity .25s ease}
@media (hover:hover){.res-post:hover .res-post_img{transform:scale(1.04)}.res-post:hover .res-post_title{opacity:.75}}
.res-post:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #146ef5;outline-offset:4px;border-radius:12px}
/* Case studies with the numbers: the active row shows its result and its site on the right, with a full white line above
   (.res-case_bar) and below (::after, over the next row's border) it; it moves on every 5s */
.res-cases.is-ready .res-case_brand{opacity:.4;transition:opacity .35s ease}
.res-cases.is-ready .res-case_stat{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .35s ease,transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.res-cases.is-ready .res-case.is-active .res-case_brand{opacity:1}
.res-cases.is-ready .res-case.is-active .res-case_stat{opacity:1;transform:none}
.res-cases.is-ready .res-case_bar{transform:scaleX(1);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s ease}
.res-case::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-1px;z-index:1;height:1px;background-color:#fff;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .35s ease}
.res-cases.is-ready .res-case.is-active .res-case_bar,.res-cases.is-ready .res-case.is-active::after{opacity:1}
.res-cases.is-ready .res-cases_preview .w-dyn-item{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .5s ease,visibility 0s linear .5s}
.res-cases.is-ready .res-cases_preview .w-dyn-item.is-active{position:relative;opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .5s ease}
.res-case:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:4px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.res-hero_track{animation:none}.res-case_bar,.res-case::after,.res-post_img,.res-hero_card{transition:none!important}}
</style>

<style>
.resources-main-featured-divider_line {
  position: relative;
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);  /* prigusena crna, 20% */
}

.resources-main-featured-divider_line::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);    /* puna crna, 100% */
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left center;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease-in-out;
}

.resources-main-featured-divider_line.is-filled::before {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.resources-main-featured-right_card');
  const lines = document.querySelectorAll('.resources-main-featured-divider_line');

  cards.forEach(function (card, i) {
    const topLine = lines[i];
    const bottomLine = lines[i + 1];

    card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
      if (topLine) topLine.classList.add('is-filled');
      if (bottomLine) bottomLine.classList.add('is-filled');
    });

    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
      if (topLine) topLine.classList.remove('is-filled');
      if (bottomLine) bottomLine.classList.remove('is-filled');
    });
  });
});
</script>
<script>
/* Integrations with Webflow: the tiles orbit the Webflow core and the selected tool shows on the left.
   It moves to the next tool every 3.6s; pointing at, tapping or tabbing to a tile takes over. Each tile carries its own
   data (data-int-name, -color, -category, -time, -text, -logo), so a tile is added or changed in the Designer only. */
(function(){
  var root=document.querySelector('[data-integrations]'); if(!root) return;
  var orb=root.querySelector('.integrations_orbit'), info=root.querySelector('.integrations_info'), fx=root.querySelector('.integrations_fx'),
      logo=root.querySelector('.integrations_logo'), nds=[].slice.call(orb.querySelectorAll('.integrations_tile')); if(!nds.length) return;
  var F={}; [].forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('[data-int-field]'),function(e){ F[e.getAttribute('data-int-field')]=e; });
  var NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg'), gid='int-lg-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7);
  svg.setAttribute('class','integrations_lines'); svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  svg.innerHTML='<defs><linearGradient id="'+gid+'" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#146EF5"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#146EF5"/></linearGradient></defs><line stroke="url(#'+gid+')"/>';
  orb.insertBefore(svg,nds[0]);
  var lg=svg.querySelector('linearGradient'), lg2=lg.lastChild, ln=svg.querySelector('line');
  var still=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches, cur=-1, user=false, vis=false, leave=0, cyc=0, tm=0, raf=0,
      angle=0, speed=1, target=1, last=0;
  /* inner ring 6 tiles, outer ring 9; radius as a share of the orbit (the native left/top of each tile is the same layout at angle 0) */
  var P=nds.map(function(n,i){ var inner=i<6; return {r:inner?.28:.47, a:(inner?i/6:(i-6)/9+.055)*Math.PI*2, dir:inner?1:-.7}; });
  nds.forEach(function(n){ n.style.left='0'; n.style.top='0'; });
  orb.classList.add('is-ready');
  function place(){ var W=orb.clientWidth, s=nds[0].offsetWidth, h=orb.classList.contains('is-hold');
    nds.forEach(function(n,i){ var p=P[i], a=p.a+angle*p.dir, x=W/2+Math.cos(a)*p.r*W-s/2, y=W/2+Math.sin(a)*p.r*W-s/2;
      n.style.transform='translate('+x.toFixed(1)+'px,'+y.toFixed(1)+'px) scale('+(h&&i===cur?1.18:1)+')'; });
    if(cur>-1){ var q=P[cur], b=q.a+angle*q.dir, x2=W/2+Math.cos(b)*q.r*W, y2=W/2+Math.sin(b)*q.r*W;
      svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 '+W+' '+W);
      [ln,lg].forEach(function(e){ e.setAttribute('x1',W/2); e.setAttribute('y1',W/2); e.setAttribute('x2',x2.toFixed(1)); e.setAttribute('y2',y2.toFixed(1)); }); } }
  /* the orbit glides, and eases to a stop while someone points at a tool; it only runs while the section is on screen */
  function loop(t){ raf=0; if(!vis) return; var dt=last?Math.min(50,t-last):16; last=t; speed+=(target-speed)*.06; if(!still) angle+=speed*dt*.00006; place(); raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
  function run(){ if(!raf){ last=0; raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop); } }
  function d(n,k){ return n.getAttribute('data-int-'+k)||''; }
  function fill(n){ var name=d(n,'name');
    if(logo){ logo.removeAttribute('srcset'); logo.removeAttribute('sizes'); logo.src=d(n,'logo'); logo.alt=name; }
    if(F.title) F.title.textContent='Webflow + '+name; if(F.text) F.text.textContent=d(n,'text');
    if(F.category) F.category.textContent=d(n,'category'); if(F.time) F.time.textContent=d(n,'time'); }
  function show(i,now){ if(i===cur) return; cur=i; var n=nds[i], c=d(n,'color')||'#146EF5';
    orb.classList.add('is-hold'); nds.forEach(function(m,j){ m.classList.toggle('is-active',j===i); });
    lg2.setAttribute('stop-color',c); svg.classList.add('is-on'); root.style.setProperty('--int-c',c);
    clearTimeout(tm);
    if(now){ fill(n); } else { fx.classList.add('is-out'); tm=setTimeout(function(){ fill(n); fx.classList.remove('is-out'); },180); }
    if(F.bar){ F.bar.style.animation='none'; void F.bar.offsetWidth; F.bar.style.animation=''; }
    if(!raf) place(); }
  function cycle(){ clearTimeout(cyc); if(user||!vis) return; info.classList.add('is-auto'); cyc=setTimeout(function(){ show((cur+1)%nds.length); cycle(); },3600); }
  function take(i){ clearTimeout(leave); clearTimeout(cyc); user=true; target=0; info.classList.remove('is-auto'); show(i); }
  function free(ms){ clearTimeout(leave); leave=setTimeout(function(){ user=false; target=1; cycle(); },ms); }
  nds.forEach(function(n,i){
    n.addEventListener('pointerenter',function(e){ if(e.pointerType==='mouse') take(i); });
    n.addEventListener('pointerleave',function(e){ if(e.pointerType==='mouse') free(500); });
    n.addEventListener('pointerup',function(e){ if(e.pointerType!=='mouse'){ take(i); free(5000); } });
    n.addEventListener('focus',function(){ if(n.matches(':focus-visible')) take(i); });
    n.addEventListener('blur',function(){ if(user) free(500); });
    n.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); take(i); } });
  });
  show(Math.max(0,nds.findIndex(function(n){ return d(n,'name')===(F.title?F.title.textContent.replace(/^Webflow \+ /,''):''); })),true);
  addEventListener('resize',function(){ if(!raf) place(); });
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window){ new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ vis=es[0].isIntersecting; if(vis){ run(); cycle(); } else clearTimeout(cyc); },{rootMargin:'100px 0px'}).observe(orb); }
  else { vis=true; run(); cycle(); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Resources hero: counts come from the hidden collection lists and the orbit tiles; the stats light one kind of card every
   3.2s (hover or focus takes over); both rows get insights, case studies and integrations in turn and glide in a loop. */
(function(){
  var hero=document.querySelector('[data-res-hero]'); if(!hero) return;
  var still=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches, T=['insight','case','integration'];
  [].forEach.call(hero.querySelectorAll('[data-res-count]'),function(el){ var t=el.getAttribute('data-res-count'), n=0, src;
    if(t==='integration') n=document.querySelectorAll('[data-integrations] .integrations_tile').length;
    else if((src=hero.querySelector('[data-res-count-src="'+t+'"]'))) n=src.querySelectorAll('.w-dyn-item').length;
    if(n) el.textContent=n; });
  var rows=[].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('[data-res-row]')), pool={insight:[],'case':[],integration:[]};
  rows.forEach(function(r){ [].forEach.call(r.querySelectorAll('[data-res-card]'),function(c){ var t=c.getAttribute('data-res-card'); if(pool[t]) pool[t].push(c); }); });
  rows.forEach(function(row,ri){
    var q={}, left=0, seq=[], k=0, pat=ri%2?['case','integration','insight']:T;
    T.forEach(function(t){ q[t]=pool[t].filter(function(c,i){ return i%rows.length===ri; }); left+=q[t].length; });
    if(!left) return;
    while(left){ var t=pat[k++%3]; if(q[t].length){ seq.push(q[t].shift()); left--; } }
    var track=document.createElement('div'); track.className='res-hero_track';
    seq.forEach(function(c){ track.appendChild(c); });
    while(row.firstChild) row.removeChild(row.firstChild);
    row.appendChild(track); row.classList.add('is-running');
    /* one set must be wider than the screen; then the set is doubled so the loop has no seam */
    var base=seq.slice(), n=0;
    while(track.scrollWidth<innerWidth*1.15&&n++<6) base.forEach(function(c){ var x=c.cloneNode(true); x.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); track.appendChild(x); });
    var w=track.scrollWidth;
    [].slice.call(track.children).forEach(function(c){ var x=c.cloneNode(true); x.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); track.appendChild(x); });
    track.style.setProperty('--res-dur',Math.max(20,Math.round(w/38))+'s');
  });
  var stats=[].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('[data-res-type]')), types=stats.map(function(s){ return s.getAttribute('data-res-type'); }),
      cur=Math.max(0,types.indexOf(hero.getAttribute('data-res-active'))), timer=0, held=false, vis=true;
  function set(i){ cur=i; hero.setAttribute('data-res-active',types[i]); stats.forEach(function(s,j){ s.classList.toggle('is-active',j===i); }); }
  function loop(){ clearTimeout(timer); if(held||still||!vis||stats.length<2) return; timer=setTimeout(function(){ set((cur+1)%stats.length); loop(); },3200); }
  stats.forEach(function(s,i){
    s.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){ held=true; clearTimeout(timer); set(i); });
    s.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){ held=false; loop(); });
    s.addEventListener('focus',function(){ held=true; clearTimeout(timer); set(i); });
    s.addEventListener('blur',function(){ held=false; loop(); });
  });
  set(cur);
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window) new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ vis=es[0].isIntersecting; hero.classList.toggle('is-off',!vis); if(vis) loop(); else clearTimeout(timer); }).observe(hero);
  else loop();
})();
/* Case studies with the numbers: the rows and the previews are two lists of the same projects, matched by position.
   The active row shows its result and its site on the right; it moves on every 5s, hover or focus takes over. */
(function(){
  var root=document.querySelector('[data-res-cases]'); if(!root) return;
  var rows=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.res-case')), prev=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.res-cases_preview .w-dyn-item'));
  if(!rows.length) return;
  var DUR=5000, cur=0, timer=0, held=false, vis=false, still=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  root.style.setProperty('--res-case-dur',DUR/1000+'s');
  function show(i){ cur=i; rows.forEach(function(r,j){ r.classList.toggle('is-active',j===i); }); prev.forEach(function(p,j){ p.classList.toggle('is-active',j===i); });
    var bar=rows[i].querySelector('.res-case_bar'); if(bar){ bar.style.animation='none'; void bar.offsetWidth; bar.style.animation=''; } }
  function loop(){ clearTimeout(timer); var on=!held&&vis&&!still&&rows.length>1; root.classList.toggle('is-auto',on); if(on) timer=setTimeout(function(){ show((cur+1)%rows.length); loop(); },DUR); }
  function take(i){ held=true; clearTimeout(timer); root.classList.remove('is-auto'); show(i); }
  rows.forEach(function(r,i){
    r.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){ take(i); });
    r.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){ held=false; loop(); });
    r.addEventListener('focus',function(){ take(i); });
    r.addEventListener('blur',function(){ held=false; loop(); });
  });
  root.classList.add('is-ready'); show(0);
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window) new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ vis=es[0].isIntersecting; loop(); },{threshold:.25}).observe(root);
  else { vis=true; loop(); }
})();
</script>
